observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for an LG DVD Home Theater System.
The box identifies the model as LHD667.
The box indicates a power output of 600 W RMS.
The box features icons for DVD, Bluetooth, Full HD, and Dolby Audio.
The box shows an illustration of two floor-standing speakers and a central player unit.
The bottom of the box appears slightly crushed or worn.
No photos of the actual electronic components or speakers are provided.

claims.claim: Lg 600w dvd bluetooth home theater system

claims.evidence: The box mentions 'Built-in Subwoofers' but does not explicitly state 2.2 channel configuration.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different item.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual player and speakers outside of the box.

risks.risk: The system may not power on or function correctly.
risks.proof: Video of the unit powered on and playing audio from a disc or Bluetooth.

risks.risk: Physical damage to speaker cones or the player unit.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the speaker drivers (with grilles off if possible) and the player's front/rear panels.

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories like the remote control or speaker cables.
risks.proof: Photo showing the remote, power cables, and speaker wires.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual speakers and player unit outside of the box.
A video showing the system powered on and playing sound.
Photos of the remote control and all included cables.
Close-up photos of the model/serial number plate on the back of the main unit.
response.reason: Only the retail box is shown. For second-hand goods, photos of the actual items are required to verify their existence, condition, and completeness.
